about: Golden figures for the vehicle P&L rules, worked by hand from the owner's workbook (Vehicle Trip Entry Form). Read by packages/domain/src/vehicle-pl.test.ts and apps/api/tests/test_vehicle_pl_domain.py. Money is a string, quantities may be numbers.

cases.name: one trip carries everything written on its sheet: profit AV − AB − BH, GST to pay apart, a customer part paid
three trips share the sheet's linked diesel, batta and maintenance by km; sheet payments settle the oldest trip first; accounts closed one trip
trips with no km share the sheet's costs evenly, the leftover paisa to the earlier trip number; a trip's own batta and police add to its share
a sheet with no trip yet: its costs are a loss, and a payment on it is an advance
a void bill counts nothing; a loss on one trip; a customer paid extra; GST rounded once per line
one trip without a km reading: the sheet's costs and km are shared evenly

spread.name: by km when every trip has a reading
evenly when no trip has a reading, the leftover paisa to the earlier trip
evenly when one trip has no reading
nothing to share with no trip

doubleCounts.name: the same bill linked on the sheet and on a trip
a typed line repeating a diesel bill already in Linck, and two lines with one bill number
a typed line repeating a bill on another sheet of the vehicle, not of another vehicle
